bugs.title: rSeries 5900 Error - Thermal fault detected in hardware
bugs.symptoms: An rSeries 5900 displays the following error message: "WARNING: Thermal fault detected in hardware" This issue occurs intermittently on reboot at normal operating temperature. It is a false alarm.
bugs.conditions: Reboot a device running at operating temperature.
bugs.impact: Produces alarm message after reboot on the LCD that indicates the device is or has exceeded operating temperature, even when it's operating within normal operating temperature ranges.
bugs.fix: BIOS update fixes faulty thermal threshold configuration code that was causing false thermal event upon reboot.

bugs.title: STP Validation for forward-delay, max-age, and hello-time fields
bugs.symptoms: One or more forwarding-delay, max-age, or hello-time fields are configured and are not mirrored as operational data, or One or more forwarding-delay, max-age, or hello-time fields are configured, and the configuration is not reflected in the spanning-tree BPDUs.
bugs.conditions: When configuring STP, use this formula for the forwarding-delay, max-age, and hello-time fields for STP, RSTP, and MSTP configurations: 2 * (hello-time + 1)) <= max-age && max-age <= (2 * (forwarding-delay - 1
bugs.impact: Any configuration that does not match the expected formula will not propagate to spanning tree BPDUs.
bugs.workaround: Configure the forward-delay, max-age, and hello-time fields using this formula: 2 * (hello-time + 1)) <= max-age && max-age <= (2 * (forwarding-delay - 1
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue where a user could configure the forward-delay, max-age, and hello-time fields for STP so that the expected formula was not met. Entering an invalid configuration displays an error.

bugs.title: Qkview availability
bugs.symptoms: Under certain conditions, the qkview container stops responding.
bugs.conditions: Unspecified conditions.
bugs.impact: No qkview functionality.

bugs.title: Disabling appliance mode without ConfD running
bugs.symptoms: When appliance mode is enabled (default behavior with setip wizard) and if CC ConfD does not come up (due to hardware or software bug, for example), there is no mechanism (other than to reimage the chassis) to disable appliance mode and recover the system.
bugs.conditions: Appliance mode is enabled (default behavior with setip wizard) and CC ConfD does not come up.
bugs.impact: There is no mechanism (other than to reimage the chassis) to disable appliance mode and recover the system.
bugs.fix: Appliance mode can be disabled via SSH command and serial console login scripts.

bugs.title: Container hardening
bugs.symptoms: Access controls on the file list/show command are not enforced as expected.
bugs.conditions: - Authenticated administrative user - File list command
bugs.impact: User may list directories not intended to be exposed.
bugs.fix: The file list command now enforces controls as expected

bugs.title: Admin cannot edit the tenant config in Deployed state from GUI if the tenants are created via CLI; downgrading partition or rSeries appliance may leave device inoperative
bugs.symptoms: Trying to modify a tenant via the GUI or API may not work if the tenant was created via the CLI, and is deployed. Attempting to downgrade an rSeries appliance from F5OS-A 1.1.0 or above to F5OS-A 1.0.x may fail if the device has any tenants deployed. This leaves the system inoperative, with errors similar to the following in /var/F5/system/log/confd.log: <CRIT> 5-Jun-2022::03:17:21.056 appliance-1 confd[105]: - CDB: Upgrade failed: Upgrade transaction failed to validate: /f5-tenants:tenants/tenant{otters}/config/storage/size (value "90"): Storage size can be modified only if tenant is in Configured or Provisioned state. Attempting to downgrade an F5OS-C partition from F5OS-C 1.3.0 or above to F5OS-C 1.2.1 or below may fail if the partition has any tenants deployed. The partition should continue running on the "from" target version.
bugs.conditions: Admin creates the tenant via CLI and subsequently edits the following tenant config when the running-state is set to Deployed: -- Scale-up/Scale-down the tenant. -- Add/Remove VLAN.
bugs.impact: Admin cannot scale up/scale down the cluster using the GUI if the tenant is initially deployed via CLI. Downgrades of F5OS-A appliance or F5OS-C partition may fail or leave the system inoperative.
bugs.workaround: Use the CLI to scale-up/scale-down and add/remove the VLAN to the tenant. When performing a downgrade, set the tenants to Provisioned first.

bugs.title: VELOS system controller/chassis partition should support a system hostname
bugs.symptoms: System hostname is missing in operational data (state data). For example: Even after configuring the system hostname, it is not visible when you run the "show system state hostname" command. syscon-2-active# show system state hostname % No entries found.
bugs.conditions: 1. Configure hostname in config mode using this command: system config hostname <name> 2. Display the configured hostname using this command: show system state hostname
bugs.impact: Hostname is not visible in state information.
bugs.workaround: Check for the configured hostname from the system controller login prompt or by checking the running configuration using the "show running-config system config hostname" command.
bugs.fix: Hostname now displays when you use the "show system state hostname" command.
bugs.behavior: The "show system state hostname" command now provides a valid response and displays the currently-set hostname.

bugs.title: Using curl to access 'scp:' URIs on the partition management IP does not work
bugs.symptoms: Attempting to upload a tenant image via "curl filename scp:IMAGES" would fail, even though "scp filename admin@mgmt-ip:IMAGES" works.
bugs.conditions: Accessing ssh/scp via curl rather that the scp application.
bugs.impact: Cannot use curl to copy files.
bugs.workaround: Use scp directly rather than curl.
bugs.fix: The ssh/scp server has been fixed to correctly interpret the file/directory names supplied by the 'curl' command.

bugs.title: Tenant virtual disk is deleted when the tenant running-state is set to "configured."
bugs.symptoms: A VELOS tenant's virtual-disk is deleted when the tenant running-state is set back to "configured" after having been "deployed." This behavior differs from vCMP. It is recommended that you set the tenant running-state to "provisioned" in order to stop the running tenant.
bugs.conditions: Tenant running-state changed from "deployed" to "configured."
bugs.impact: Virtual disk is deleted, resulting in loss of tenant configuration.
bugs.workaround: Fixed. No workaround needed.
bugs.fix: The system no longer deletes the virtual disk when the state is changed from deployed to configured.

bugs.title: DNS servers attained through DHCP not reflected in confd
bugs.symptoms: When DHCP is enabled on the management interface, DNS servers are attained by DHCP server. The 'show system dns' command in confd does not show the DNS entries fetched by the DHCP server.
bugs.conditions: Enable DHCP on the management interface from confd
bugs.impact: DNS server IPs fetched dynamically by the DHCP server are not displayed by confd
bugs.fix: Fixed code to update confd with DNS server IP addresses when DHCP is enabled on the management interface

bugs.title: Source address for TACACS+ server group configuration does not work
bugs.symptoms: Attempting to set the source-address for a TACACS+ server group configuration might fail or does not work as expected.
bugs.conditions: Attempt to configure source-address for TACACS+ server group.
bugs.impact: No functional impact, as the source-address isn't used.
bugs.workaround: The source-address is not used by the TACACS+ client. Do not configure source-address.
bugs.fix: The source-address config element is now removed for TACACS+ server-group configuration.

bugs.title: Permissions of some QKView control files do not follow standards
bugs.symptoms: Permissions of some QKView control files do not follow standards.
bugs.conditions: Viewing permissions of QKView files.
bugs.impact: Some do not follow standards.
bugs.fix: Permissions of all QKView control files now follow the standards.

bugs.title: openssl: Read buffer overruns processing ASN.1 strings
bugs.symptoms: The openssl assumes that the ASN.1 strings are terminated by the null character in the end. When the malicious actor sends a crafted ASN.1 string without a null character through one of the openssl's public API. This can result in the application crash and denial of service.
bugs.conditions: A crafted message having a ASN.1 string without a null terminated character. This message can be sent through the openssl's public API functions.
bugs.impact: This can result in application crash, causing a Denial of Service, or possibly memory disclosure. The threat from this vulnerability is data confidentiality and system availability.
bugs.workaround: No workaround available.
bugs.fix: The vulnerability is known to affect the openssl versions 1.0.2y and below. We have updated our openssl versions to 1.0.2Zc which has the fix for the vulnerability mentioned

bugs.title: SM2 cannot be used for creating self-signed certificates
bugs.symptoms: When creating a self-signed certificate, VELOS returns an error. The create self-signed certificate function allows for elliptic curves but does not work for 'SM2'.
bugs.conditions: When requesting a certificate using type ec, the curve name SM2 can be selected.
bugs.impact: Attempting to use SM2 curve name results in an error.
bugs.workaround: Outside confd you can create the SM2 key using: /usr/bin/openssl ecparam -genkey -name SM2 The key can then be entered using system-aaa-tls-config-key and subsequently used to create a CSR. The self-signed certificate would need to be done using openssl commands and entered manually if to be stored.
bugs.fix: The SM2 curve name can now be used like all the other ec curve names.

bugs.title: sw_rbcast core file found on system
bugs.symptoms: partition_sw_rbcast producing core.
bugs.conditions: Starting a tenant which requires the sw_rbcast container.
bugs.impact: The sw_rbcast process crashes and produces a core file.
bugs.fix: A new version of sw_rbcast correctly handles tenant broadcast packets.

bugs.title: The "show components" component PSU does not show sn/pn after PSU hot-swap
bugs.symptoms: The "show components" command displays the wrong state for the PSU when the PSU has been physically removed.
bugs.conditions: When the PSU is hot-swapped on the hardware.
bugs.impact: After the PSU is hot-swapped on the hardware, the "show components" command displays the wrong state for the PSU.
bugs.fix: The "show components" command displays the correct state/data for the PSU when the PSU has been physically removed.

bugs.title: QKView list and status results are difficult to parse
bugs.symptoms: The QKView list and status commands return output that can be difficult to read. Example 1 :: running the command: system diagnostics qkview list: frodo# system diagnostics qkview list result {"Qkviews":[{"Filename":"appliance-1.qkview","Date":"2022-06-15T22:59:57.704997979Z","Size":320434703},{"Filename":"cancelme.tar.canceled","Date":"2022-04-28T17:22:10.411870757Z","Size":3734340},{"Filename":"duplicate.qkview","Date":"2022-08-10T20:40:10.966027168Z","Size":490039715},{"Filename":"test.qkview","Date":"2022-06-15T23:21:23.068041954Z","Size":321199668},{"Filename":"test2.qkview","Date":"2022-07-13T19:01:32.712663042Z","Size":416706874},{"Filename":"teststatus.qkview","Date":"2022-08-23T23:27:19.283797639Z","Size":530892644}]} resultint 0 This output is easier to parse: FILENAME SIZE CREATED ON ------------------------------------------------------------------ teststatus.qkview 530892644 2022-08-23T23:27:19.283797639Z duplicate.qkview 490039715 2022-08-10T20:40:10.966027168Z test2.qkview 416706874 2022-07-13T19:01:32.712663042Z test.qkview 321199668 2022-06-15T23:21:23.068041954Z appliance-1.qkview 320434703 2022-06-15T22:59:57.704997979Z cancelme.tar.canceled 3734340 2022-04-28T17:22:10.411870757Z Example 2 :: running the command: system diagnostics qkview status: result {"Busy":false,"Percent":100,"Status":"complete","Message":"Completed collection.","Filename":"teststatus.qkview"} resultint 0 This output is easier to parse: system diagnostics qkview state status capture-in-progress false system diagnostics qkview state status percentage 100 system diagnostics qkview state status status-msg "Completed collection." system diagnostics qkview state status filename teststatus.qkview
bugs.conditions: - Running "system diagnostics qkview list" within the CLI - Running "system diagnostics qkview status" within the CLI
bugs.impact: Formatting of output makes troubleshooting more difficult.
bugs.fix: QKView output formatting is improved and easier to read, utilizing new commands. To see a list of QKView files, use the following command within the CLI: show system diagnostics qkview state files To see the current status of a captured QKView, use the following command within the CLI: show system diagnostics qkview state status

bugs.title: VLAN shared between two tenants might not pass traffic to tenant with non-default CMP hash.
bugs.symptoms: If two tenants on a VELOS chassis are configured with a shared VLAN, one tenant might not pass traffic if it has a non-default CMP hash configured for that VLAN.
bugs.conditions: -- VELOS chassis -- Configure a VLAN shared between two or more tenants -- In one tenant, configure a non-default CMP hash for the VLAN
bugs.impact: No connectivity.
bugs.workaround: After configuring a non-default cmp hash, run "docker restart partition_sw_rbcast" on each blade.
bugs.fix: Fixed operation of shared VLAN when cmp hash is not the default.

bugs.title: Tenant datapath will not work if the tenant is named "stpd".
bugs.symptoms: If a tenant is created with the name "stpd", there will be a conflict with a system component. The datapath will not function correctly.
bugs.conditions: A tenant is created with the name "stpd".
bugs.impact: The datapath for the tenant will not function.
bugs.workaround: Change the name of the tenant.

bugs.title: Qkview capture with timeout does not stop capture after timeout
bugs.symptoms: Qkview capture does not stop when the timeout value expires. Qkview ignores the timeout setting and proceeds with collection.
bugs.conditions: Timeout value is exceeded in the qkview capture command
bugs.impact: Qkview does not stop capture after the timeout expires
bugs.workaround: Invoke qkview cancel command to stop the capture manually after the timeout value. `system diagnostics qkview cancel`
bugs.fix: Timeout is handled correctly to stop qkview capture after timeout.

bugs.title: Portgroup state set to empty strings when optic removed
bugs.symptoms: When an optical transceiver is removed from a front panel port the portgroup state information in confd is set to empty strings
bugs.conditions: Physical removal of an optical transceiver in VELOS or rSeries
bugs.impact: Empty string is returned to REST call for portgroups/portgroup/state information when optic is removed.
bugs.fix: When an optical transceiver is removed from a front panel port the portgroup state is completely removed and will not show up in confd at all.

bugs.title: Libvirt core is generated on system reboot
bugs.symptoms: A flawed core file is generated on system reboot intermittently. But the tenant is actually healthy and functional after reboot.
bugs.conditions: Intermittently on system reboots.
bugs.impact: A libvirt core file is generated, but the tenant is actually healthy and functional.
bugs.fix: No impact on functionality. No user action is expected.

bugs.title: Snd_hda_intel 0000:00:1f.3: no codecs found.
bugs.symptoms: During a reboot, error messages related to snd_hda_intel are logged: "snd_hda_intel 0000:00:1f.3: no codecs found!"
bugs.conditions: This occurs during a reboot of an rSeries appliance.
bugs.impact: No functional impact, the error can be safely ignored.
bugs.fix: An erroneous error message has been suppressed.

bugs.title: Lacpd process continuously restarts after creating a LAG interface with a space.&start;
bugs.symptoms: Lacpd service restarts when the LAG name contains space. The tenant wont get the LAG name and it will show a null value. [root@localhost:Active:Standalone] config # tmsh list net trunk net trunk "" { cfg-mbr-count 2 distribution-hash src-dst-mac id 0 interfaces { 1.0 2.0 } stp disabled type ha-only working-mbr-count 2 }
bugs.conditions: LAG name contains a space. Example : "lacp lag" appliance-1(config)# interfaces interface "lacp lag" config type ieee8023adLag
bugs.impact: 1. Lacpd service restarts. 2. BIG-IP tenant does not get the trunk name. Note: In case of live upgrade from EA to GA release, any LAG created with a space in name will not work and you will need to either delete these or do a bare metal install before performing a live upgrade.
bugs.workaround: Don't create a LAG name that has space in the name.

bugs.title: Tenants are in pending state forever.
bugs.symptoms: Tenants never enter into running state.
bugs.conditions: If a tenant request contains more vCPUs greater than available vCPUs on the system.
bugs.impact: -- Tenants go into pending state forever. -- Empty CPUs are listed under tenants state in confd.
bugs.workaround: Always follow defined product License capability to configure vCPUs for a tenant.

bugs.title: "Failed unmounting" errors during shutdown.
bugs.symptoms: "Failed unmounting" errors are seen during the shutdown, because of unmounting of temporary directories, which are created during the SW import. [FAILED] Failed unmounting /var/images/R5R10/1.0.0-10192. [FAILED] Failed unmounting /var/export/chass...mounts/iso/R5R10/1.0.0-10192/m3. [FAILED] Failed unmounting /var/export/chass...unts/services/R5R10/1.0.0-10192.
bugs.conditions: The "Failed unmounting" errors are seen when a system is rebooted.
bugs.impact: Error statements are seen in the shutdown logs. They can be ignored.

bugs.title: Tenant Status shows error "Insufficient f5.com/qat"
bugs.symptoms: Some unhealthy events intermittently occur that are related to "Insufficient f5.com/qat" inside ConfD. But the tenant is actually healthy and functional.
bugs.conditions: Intermittently on a system upgrade. Tenant status might show failed messages in ConfD.
bugs.impact: No impact, the tenant is actually healthy and functional.
bugs.workaround: No workaround necessary.
bugs.fix: Issue fixed in F5OS-A 1.3.0 release.

bugs.title: Changing the system date to be older than the installation date is not supported.
bugs.symptoms: All system self-signed certificates are generated using the installation system date. Changing the date to an older date than the installation date can cause instability.
bugs.conditions: Setting the system date to be older than the installation date on an rSeries appliance.
bugs.impact: System goes to unstable state.
bugs.workaround: N/A ★ This issue may cause the configuration to fail to load or may significantly impact system performance after upgrade *********************** NOTICE *********************** For additional support resources and technical documentation, see: The F5 Technical Support website: http://www.f5.com/support/ The MyF5 website: https://my.f5.com/manage/s/ The F5 DevCentral website: http://community.f5.com/ ****************************************************** Generated: Fri Oct 9 13:23:38 2026 UTC ©2026 F5, Inc. bugs.title: Duplicate broadcast/multicast packets are sent out a front panel interface.
bugs.symptoms: Clients may report 'duplicate response' due to multiple copies of the same broadcast/multicast packet.
bugs.conditions: Tenant generated broadcast/multicast traffic destined to a front-panel interface.
bugs.impact: No functional impact. Clients may report 'duplicate response' messages.
bugs.fix: Correct hardware programming to only send one copy of broadcast/multicast out a front-panel interface.

bugs.title: Traffic over shared VLANs does not work
bugs.symptoms: When two tenants share a VLAN, ARP replies from the tenants are not forwarded to the front-panel interfaces.
bugs.conditions: Two tenants sharing a VLAN
bugs.impact: Traffic does not work over shared VLANs
bugs.fix: Program service DAG entries into the ATSE-NSE logic.

bugs.title: Sw_rbcast container restarts on non-fatal errors
bugs.symptoms: VELOS logs indicate a disconnect and restart of the sw_rbcast container: appliance-1 sw-rbcast[20]: priority="Notice" version=1.0 msgid=0x6903000000000003 msg="Software Rebroadcaster disconnected from Host DMA-Agent." error=3. appliance-1 sw-rbcast[20]: priority="Info" version=1.0 msgid=0x6903000000000002 msg="Software Rebroadcaster connected to Host DMA-Agent".
bugs.conditions: High volume (> 200k packets/second) of broadcast traffic.
bugs.impact: None. The container restarts and continues to process traffic.
bugs.fix: Container no longer restarts for non-fatal errors.

bugs.title: Unable to import VELOS images from the F5 downloads site
bugs.symptoms: Importing images from the F5 downloads site using the VELOS GUI fails.
bugs.conditions: -- Using direct links to the VELOS image on the F5 downloads site. -- The URL contains a query string with parameters.
bugs.impact: The VELOS system fails to download the image from the F5 downloads site.
bugs.workaround: Use the confd CLI to download the file: 1. Using your web browser, navigate to the appropriate "Select a Download" screen for the file that you wish to download directly to the VELOS system 2. Copy the URL for the file 3. Use the file import command, ensuring that you put the remote-url value in quotation marks, for example: syscon-1-active# file import remote-url "https://downloads07.f5.com/esd/download.sv?loc=downloads07.f5.com/downloads/53b686a5-d1cc-484d-af8b-5decd705d174/F5OS-C-1.2.2-12471.CONTROLLER.iso" local-file images/staging/ To check the download status, run the following command: file transfer-status
bugs.fix: You can now import VELOS images from the F5 downloads site.

bugs.title: Interface counters are slow to update
bugs.symptoms: Interface counters do not immediately reflect traffic activity.
bugs.conditions: Normal user traffic
bugs.impact: Interface counters may not reflect the exact amount of traffic due to being slow to update.
bugs.fix: Increase counter polling frequency.

bugs.title: MD5 cipher is allowed on RESTCONF port 8888 with FIPS-enabled license.
bugs.symptoms: When a FIPS-enabled license is installed on the system, some MD5 ciphers are allowed on RESTCONF port 8888, when they should not be allowed.
bugs.conditions: The command "openssl s_client -connect <mgmt-ip>:8888 -cipher MD5" returns a valid certificate.
bugs.impact: MD5 SSLCipher continues to work on port 8888 on both system controller and chassis partition management IP addresses.
bugs.fix: Removed MD5 SSLCipherSuites from ssl.conf when a FIPS-enabled license is installed on the system.

bugs.title: K3S service does not start after system downgrade.&start;
bugs.symptoms: During tenant deployment, the "compute" pod fails to come up. Multiple kubehelper pods will be triggered.
bugs.conditions: This can occur after a downgrade.
bugs.impact: Tenant deployments fail.
bugs.workaround: 1) manually delete the script /var/F5/system/apigw-tenant-helper.sh before the downgrade 2) If you forget to delete the script (step 1), recovery options are a) remove the file and reboot the system b) perform a bare metal install

bugs.title: Message of the Day not working for admin user
bugs.symptoms: Message of the Day (MOTD) is not displayed when the admin user logs in to BIG-IP Next.
bugs.conditions: Message of the day (MOTD) is configured on the BIG-IP Next.
bugs.impact: Admin users do not see the MOTD banner when they log in.
bugs.fix: MOTD is now displayed if configured.

bugs.title: Change in the procedure of PXE installation for appliances.
bugs.symptoms: There is a change in the procedure of PXE installation for appliances, defined at https://techdocs.f5.com/en-us/f5os-a-1-0-0/f5-rseries-systems-installation-upgrade/title-install-upgrade-software.html#clean-install
bugs.conditions: After PXE install, the ISO needs to be copied to /var/export/chassis/import/iso folder before doing any other import activities.
bugs.impact: If this step is skipped, issues will occur with the software import and upgrade process.
bugs.fix: Fixed an issue with the documentation.

bugs.title: The r10000 and r5000 platforms may reuse the MAC address for both management and data plane.
bugs.symptoms: The MAC address assigned to the macvlan interface mgmt0-system may also be assigned to a dataplane object: a lag or a tenant.
bugs.conditions: More than 233 lags or tenants are configured on a r10000 or r5000 platforms.
bugs.impact: If the management interface mgmt0-system and the lag or tenant are on the same broadcast domain, both devices will have communication problems. Duplicate MACs going to different switches will be fine.
bugs.workaround: The MAC address that will be duplicated is 0xfc offset from the basemac. If a tenant or lag has been assigned basemac+0xfc remove the tenant or lag, reduce the number of lags + tenants to less than 252, then re-create the tenant or lag - checking to make sure the assigned MAC does not use offset 0xfc from the base MAC.
bugs.fix: The pool of available MAC addresses to be used for tenants or lags on r10000 and r5000 platforms has been reduced from 236 to 233 to ensure unique MACs are supplied for all interfaces, lags and tenants.

bugs.title: The 'show portgroups portgroup' command is slow when no optical transceivers are plugged into front panel ports.
bugs.symptoms: The 'show portgroups portgroup' command is slow when no optical transceivers are plugged into front panel ports. This affects the CLI, GUI, and RESTCONF.
bugs.conditions: R5000 and r1000 platforms with sparsely populated or empty front panel ports.
bugs.impact: Slow response to portgroup information on unpopulated front panel ports. No functional impact - just slow reporting.

bugs.title: VELOS GUI occasionally shows stale content after upgrading&start;
bugs.symptoms: After upgrading VELOS and reloading a page, the GUI sometimes displays stale content in the browser cache.
bugs.conditions: After upgrading VELOS software upgrade and the browser cache settings are set to allow caching.
bugs.impact: Stale content is displayed.
bugs.workaround: Empty your browser cache and reload the page to display the latest content.
bugs.fix: This issue is fixed and the correct content is displayed after upgrading.

bugs.title: VLAN connectivity among F5OS tenants is lost
bugs.symptoms: Inbound ARP broadcasts on VLANs shared by tenants on VELOS or rSeries system are not received, and shared VLAN connectivity among tenants is lost.
bugs.conditions: A high volume of DLF packets are handled by the software rebroadcaster
bugs.impact: Loss of connectivity on VLANs shared among tenants.
bugs.workaround: On a VELOS system, restart the sw_rbcast container on the affected blade: # docker restart partition_sw_rbcast On an rSeries appliance, restart the sw_rbcast container on the appliance: # docker restart system_sw_rbcast
bugs.fix: This issue no longer occurs.

bugs.title: LAG names starting with a digit
bugs.symptoms: Provisioning a VELOS tenant with a LAG name that begins with a digit can fail.
bugs.conditions: -- Configuring a LAG with a name that begins with a digit. -- Provisioning a BIG-IP tenant
bugs.impact: VELOS tenant fails.
bugs.workaround: Do not configure LAG names that start with a digit.
bugs.fix: LAG names with digits are no longer allowed.

bugs.title: Error shown when configuring known-host for file transfer when FIPS mode is enabled`
bugs.symptoms: "Host unreachable" error is sometimes displayed when FIPS mode is enabled, if a user tries to configure known-host. The ssh-keyscan fails, as ssh-keyscan is not using FIPS approved ciphers.
bugs.conditions: - FIPS mode is enabled - User configures known-host for file transfer
bugs.impact: "Host unreachable" error is thrown.
bugs.fix: Updated ssh-keyscan to use FIPS approved ciphers when FIPS mode is enabled.

bugs.title: "Appliance Mode" UI control intermittently will revert your selection back to its configured state when enabling or disabling.
bugs.symptoms: On the SYSTEM SETTINGS/General screen for the rSeries appliance, the "Appliance Mode" Enable/Disable radio button choice will revert back to its configured state when you're attempting to change the configuration prior to saving it.
bugs.conditions: The Enable/Disable radio button for Appliance Mode will undo your preferred selection when the screen does a periodic poll in the background to refresh state information that is displayed on the SYSTEM SETTINGS/General screen.
bugs.impact: If you attempt to either enable or disable Appliance Mode and the screen does a periodic polling refresh at the moment you make your desired selection, your selection will be reverted back to the actual current configuration state for Appliance Mode.
bugs.workaround: The impact is intermittent and only occurs at the precise moment the screen is refreshing its state information --- typically a 10 second interval. Appliance Mode can still be enabled or disabled via the webUI as long as it is within the window the screen is not doing a periodic refresh. Additionally, Appliance Mode can be enabled or disabled from the command line interface (CLI).
bugs.fix: Periodic polling on the SYSTEM SETTINGS/General screen for rSeries appliances will be disabled or removed.

bugs.title: Packets are dropped on VELOS when a masquerade MAC is on a shared VLAN
bugs.symptoms: On the VELOS platform, any packets destined to a masquerade MAC address are dropped when the masquerade MAC is located on a shared VLAN (a VLAN shared between multiple F5OS tenants). On rSeries hardware platforms, all traffic for this MAC is first handled by the software-rebroadcaster and is replicated to all tenants sharing that VLAN.
bugs.conditions: -- A masquerade MAC is configured on a shared VLAN. -- Traffic to the MAC address is initiated, that is, ping a floating self-IP. -- The packets are dropped on ingress.
bugs.impact: Connectivity issues.
bugs.workaround: Configure a static FDB entry at the partition level.
bugs.fix: Packets are no longer dropped when a masquerade MAC is on a shared VLAN.

bugs.title: Log rotation does not occur for k3s events.
bugs.symptoms: the k3s_events.log file is not rotated.
bugs.conditions: K3s provisioning from the OMD is initiated.
bugs.impact: Most of the system memory is consumed by k3s_events.log and system starts responding slowly.
bugs.workaround: Manually empty the contents of /var/log/k3s_events.log file from the system.

bugs.title: Removing a 'patch' version of services might remove the associated 'base' version as well
bugs.symptoms: Removing a 'patch' version (X.Y.Z, Z>0) of a platform ISO or services might, under certain conditions, lead to the unexpected removal of the 'base' version (X.Y.0) associated with that patch.
bugs.conditions: 1. A 'patch' ISO is imported when the 'base' associated with the patch is not already imported (example: An F5OS-C 1.2.2 ISO is imported, and F5OS-C1.2.0 is not already imported). 2. Some time later, the F5OS-C 1.2.2 ISO is removed. This also removes the 1.2.0 services.
bugs.impact: F5OS-C removes software that wasn't explicitly chosen to be removed.
bugs.workaround: To work around this issue, import the 'base' version ISO (X.Y.0) before importing any patches. If this is done, removal of a 'patch' will not remove the 'base'. If a 'base' was already removed accidentally, re-importing the 'base' ISO will also make it available again.

bugs.title: service:overall-health attribute reports OK when the service state is unhealthy
bugs.symptoms: service:overall-health value is reported as OK, when state is unhealthy.
bugs.conditions: When service state is unhealthy, service:overall-health attribute is not updated.
bugs.impact: service:overall-health is not reporting service state properly.
bugs.fix: Updated the service:overall-health attribute.

bugs.title: Admin console is displayed when SSH login with a new root user
bugs.symptoms: Non-root user is allowed to get root role. If any such user exist, they get an admin console instead of root console.
bugs.conditions: A new non-root user is created with root role. Example : appliance-1(config)# system aaa authentication users user user_test config username user_test role root
bugs.impact: non-root user with role root is restricted. Note: In case of live upgrade from previous to current release, any non-root user with root role may cause upgrade to fail (as non-root users with root role are restricted), and you will need to either delete these users or do a bare metal install before performing a live upgrade.
bugs.fix: Current fix prevents creation of a non-root user with root role.

bugs.title: Invalid error message in log when 40g transceiver is inserted
bugs.symptoms: An erroneous message is logged when a 40G optic is inserted. appliance-1 fpgamgr[22]: priority="Err" version=1.0 msgid=0x303000000000013 msg="Unsupported SFP+/SFP28 Optic" portgroup=1.
bugs.conditions: 40G optical transceiver inserted in VELOS or rSeries appliance
bugs.impact: A log message is logged at the Error level. It can be safely ignored.
bugs.fix: Errant message no longer appears.

bugs.title: Messages log has a very high number of "error" and "fail" entries
bugs.symptoms: During system bring up/reboot, various fail and error logs are seen from multiple software components.
bugs.conditions: During system boot up or if we perform multiple reboots we may see various errors/failures in log messages.
bugs.impact: User will see error/fail messages, while System bring up/reboot.
bugs.fix: Fixed the error/fail logs for few components.

bugs.title: The fpga-tables CLI command results in syntax error in configuration mode
bugs.symptoms: When in configuration mode on the CLI and entering the fpga-tables path, a syntax error is encountered. For example: r5900-2(config)# fpga-tables ? Possible completions: <cr> r5900-2(config)# fpga-tables -----------------------------^ syntax error: incomplete path r5900-2(config)#
bugs.conditions: Performing CLI commands in the fpga-tables path while in configuration mode.
bugs.impact: The fpga-tables are intended to be operational data only. Configuration of the fpga-tables path is not supported, so the impact is cosmetic. The error can be ignored.
bugs.workaround: The error can be ignored.

bugs.title: STP errors messages reported in platform.log when global STP is enabled but STP parameters are not configured in interfaces
bugs.symptoms: The VELOS platform.log contains numerous STP error messages: appliance-1 stpd[1]: priority="Err" version=1.0 msgid=0x6102000000000018 msg="Failed to write to cdb" FIELD="Adv Stp Interface name" ERRNO=8 ERRNOSTR="badly formatted or nonexistent path". appliance-1 stpd[1]: priority="Err" version=1.0 msgid=0x6102000000000018 msg="Failed to write to cdb" FIELD="Adv Stp Interface port-num" ERRNO=8 ERRNOSTR="badly formatted or nonexistent path". appliance-1 stpd[1]: priority="Err" version=1.0 msgid=0x6102000000000018 msg="Failed to write to cdb" FIELD="Adv Stp Interface port-state" ERRNO=8
bugs.conditions: The following is the correct sequence of STP configuration. appliance-1(config)# stp global config enabled-protocol RSTP appliance-1(config)# stp rstp interfaces interface 1.0 config cost 100;top appliance-1(config)# stp interfaces interface 1.0 config edge-port EDGE_AUTO link-type P2P ; appliance-1(config-interface-1.0)# exit appliance-1(config)# commit; If the command "stp rstp interfaces interface 1.0 config cost 100;top" is not run, the log messages will occur.
bugs.impact: VELOS platform.log size will grow at rate of 2MB per minute.
bugs.workaround: To stop these messages, configure the following: stp rstp interfaces interface 1.0 config cost 100;top
bugs.fix: Multiple STP errors messages are no longer logged when not needed.

bugs.title: Unable to deploy one tenant when user attempts to deploy 28 tenants on r10800
bugs.symptoms: The 28th tenant deployment fails when 28 tenants (each with 1 vCPU) are deployed. The issue is seen only with an r10800 license. 27 tenants are deployed successfully but the 28th tenant deployment fails. No issue when one tenant is deployed with 28 vCPUs
bugs.conditions: Issue is seen in the following conditions -- System has R10800 license installed -- You attempt to deploy 28 tenants -- Each tenant has only 1 vCPU
bugs.impact: 28th tenant is not deployed on r10800. The max supported tenants on r10800 is 28

bugs.title: Tenant to API gateway communication and unit-key will not work after key rotation
bugs.symptoms: The system-api-svc-gateway fails to decrypt the unit key crashes, and is unable to communicate with the tenant.
bugs.conditions: A key migration or rotation is performed in confd: system aaa primary-key
bugs.impact: Communication between the API gateway and the tenant is disrupted. Note: If no key-rotation was ever done, this issue does not occur.
bugs.workaround: To correct the current unit-key issue, invoke the config command: system database reset-to-default proceed yes To avoid the issue, disable key-rotation. To prevent key rotation, add the line '/tenants/tenant{%x}/config/unit-key' to the file in the confd-key-migration-mgr container: /tenants/tenant{%x}/config/unit-key To do so: ssh as root into the device and do the following: # docker exec -it confd-key-migration-mgr bash bash-4.2# echo "/tenants/platform-self-signed-cert/self-signed-key" >> /etc/confd-key-migration/appliance-secure-elem-manifest bash-4.2# echo "/tenants/tenant{%x}/config/unit-key" >> /etc/confd-key-migration/appliance-secure-elem-manifest bash-4.2# exit # docker restart confd-key-migration-mgr
bugs.fix: The system now adds the line to the manifest file. Because the unit-key does not get re-encrypted with the new key, after upgrading to a software version containing the fix, run the config command: system database reset-to-default proceed yes

bugs.title: Incorrect link aggregation group (LAG) / trunk information passed to tenant.
bugs.symptoms: A BIG-IP tenant running on a VELOS system incorrectly reports all "ha-only" trunk objects as up, regardless of the actual status of the trunk. BIG-IP tenants can also report incorrect status of trunks after the LAG type is changed from LACP to STATIC or vice-versa. An interface name is displayed as empty when an interface is deleted from a LAG. As a result of these, high availability (HA) group failover based on trunk status is unreliable and unusable.
bugs.conditions: -- LAGs configured on F5OS system. -- Attempting to use high availability (HA) group failover based on trunk status inside BIG-IP tenant.
bugs.impact: HA group failover based on trunk status is unreliable and unusable for BIG-IP tenants running on an F5OS system.
bugs.workaround: After configuring a new LAG in the the F5OS partition or changing a LAG type from LACP to STATIC or from STATIC to LACP, reboot the traffic blades. For rSeries devices, the entire device must be restarted. After rebooting, the ha-group trunk entries should show the expected values when one or more members are missing from the aggregate link.
bugs.fix: This issue has been corrected.

bugs.title: Newly installed license is getting replaced with old license after performing config-restore
bugs.symptoms: When database config restore is performed, the system license was getting replaced with a license that is present in the backed up database file.
bugs.conditions: Config-restore is overwriting the system license.
bugs.impact: The system license will be removed and replaced with different license.
bugs.fix: The database operations like config-restore and reset-to-default do not remove the system license. When the database config-backup is performed, the license file won't be backed up into the backup file.

bugs.title: System reboot or link down/up transition causes packet loss.
bugs.symptoms: A reboot of the system or a link down/up transition can result in packet loss on the affected front-panel interface(s).
bugs.conditions: A link down->up transition on a front panel interface or interfaces. Either initiated from the peer side or a system reboot.
bugs.impact: LACP LAGs can fail to form. Ingress traffic is not received by the tenants.
bugs.workaround: Reboot the system.
bugs.fix: Change link down processing to not reset internal hardware state of front panel MACs.

bugs.title: Tenant management IP addresses are not validated against other IPs in use by the system
bugs.symptoms: Tenant management IP addresses are not validated against other IP addresses in use by the system. This means that a user may configure a tenant management IP that is used elsewhere in the system and/or network causing a duplicate address. It is expected that the user is managing the IP allocation on their management network, and will not configure duplicates.
bugs.conditions: The user configures a tenant with a management IP that is already used by another tenant or interface in the system.
bugs.impact: This will cause issues accessing the tenant via the management IP if a duplicate is configured, as well as causing issues accessing the component/interface already using the address.
bugs.workaround: The workaround is to configure the management IP of the tenant to be an address that is not already in use. ★ This issue may cause the configuration to fail to load or may significantly impact system performance after upgrade *********************** NOTICE *********************** For additional support resources and technical documentation, see: The F5 Networks Technical Support web site: http://www.f5.com/support/ The AskF5 web site: https://support.f5.com/csp/#/home The F5 DevCentral web site: http://devcentral.f5.com/ ****************************************************** Generated: Wed Mar 22 15:49:49 2023 UTC ©2023 F5, Inc. bugs.title: List of running containers are not captured in host qkview
bugs.symptoms: List of running containers are not captured in host qkview
bugs.conditions: Collect qkview and look for list of containers running on the system from qkview file.
bugs.impact: Unable to get the list of running containers from qkview
bugs.workaround: Administrator needs to run 'docker ps' command on the system and share the output with support.
bugs.fix: Qkview includes list of running containers on the system

bugs.title: LACP does not transmit PDU's when creating a LAG
bugs.symptoms: The LAG interface creation will not be successful and tx packet count in 'show lacp' will be zero.
bugs.conditions: This issue occurs due to a race condition while creating a LAG interface and is not reproducible every time.
bugs.impact: Link aggregation of the front panel ports will not work as expected.
bugs.workaround: 1) clear newly added lag configurations a) remove lacp interface no lacp interfaces interface <lag-name> b) remove interfaces from lag no interfaces interface <interface> ethernet config aggregate-id c) remove lag interface no interfaces interface <lag-interface> 2) create Lag interface and add interfaces to the lag
bugs.fix: Fix code to remove the race condition and read lag-type as LACP

bugs.title: VerifyDmesg test failure
bugs.symptoms: An error message is seen as dmesg output: Failed to allocate irq -2147483648: -107
bugs.conditions: The error message is seen sometimes when restarting/rebooting device is complete.
bugs.impact: The error message does not impact any functionality as after the allocation of irq for SMBUS is failed, it would switch to polling mode.
bugs.workaround: NA

bugs.title: LACP waitOnAlertFd Errors
bugs.symptoms: The system posts error messages in the platform.log: LacpdHeartBeatsClient::run() waitOnAlertFd Error!
bugs.conditions: This occurs at startup, reboot, and upgrade.
bugs.impact: There is no functional impact; you can safely ignore these messages.
bugs.fix: Reduced the frequency of LACP waitOnAlertFd error messages.

bugs.title: Delay in SSH login to Appliance management IP
bugs.symptoms: SSH to Appliance management IP takes time to login
bugs.conditions: This is an intermittent issue with no specific condition to encounter this issue.
bugs.impact: Delay in login to Appliance HW
bugs.fix: Fixed code to avoid login delays

bugs.title: Loading saved config to BIG-IP fails if host modifications are made after "tmsh save sys config"
bugs.symptoms: The configuration load fails with an error similar to the following: 01070257:3: Requested VLAN member (1.5) is currently a trunk member Unexpected Error: Loading configuration process failed.
bugs.conditions: -- rSeries 4x00 or R2x00 platform -- Configuration is backed up using tmsh -- A change is made to one or more VLANs, interfaces, trunks, or type of VLANs on the host -- The BIG-IP system loads the configuration
bugs.impact: Configuration load fails.
bugs.workaround: On a failure while loading sys config, open the affected configuration file, fix the object that was changed manually, and retry loading the sys config. For example, if the load sys config at mcpd complains about "vlan member 1.x" is not found on vlan-xyz then open /config/bigip_xxx.conf file and update the vlan-xyz with vlan-member 1.x and retry the config load.

bugs.title: LACP trunks are not configured automatically in BIG-IP tenant running on F5OS chassis/appliances
bugs.symptoms: When an LACP trunk is configured on an F5OS chassis/appliance and only the native VLAN is attached, the LACP trunk will not be automatically configured on the BIG-IP tenant.
bugs.conditions: This behavior is observed only when the LACP trunk is attached to a native VLAN.
bugs.impact: LACP trunk configuration will not be applied to the BIG-IP tenant automatically when only a native VLAN is attached to it on the platform.
bugs.workaround: Configure the LACP trunk in the BIG-IP tenant manually.
bugs.fix: LACP trunks are now configured automatically in BIG-IP tenant running on F5OS chassis/appliances, as expected.

bugs.title: Invalid DNS search path causes tenants to fail to start
bugs.symptoms: Tenants fail to start, with kubevirt virt-launcher pods in a restart loop.
bugs.conditions: Configuring an invalid DNS search domain to the system.
bugs.impact: Tenants fail to start, stuck in a "Pending" state
bugs.workaround: Reconfigure the DNS search domain with valid values.

bugs.title: Tenant running instance status shows some error/warning events in confd
bugs.symptoms: Some error/warning events intermittently occur that are related to 'failed to sync cache' inside confd. But the tenant is actually healthy and functional.
bugs.conditions: Intermittently on system reboots. Tenant Status might show error messages in Confd
bugs.impact: No impact, tenant is actually healthy & functional.

bugs.title: VLAN name change is not allowed once a tenant is launched
bugs.symptoms: When you change the VLAN name on a rseries (R2x00 or R4x00) Appliance, the BIG-IP tenant does not honor the name change.
bugs.conditions: -- One or more tenants are running on a rSeries (R4x00 or R2x00) platform. -- A VLAN name is changed for a VLAN that is in use by a running tenant.
bugs.impact: Changing the VLAN name after a tenant is launched and reassigning that VLAN removes the interface in TMM.
bugs.workaround: Set the VLAN name to the initial name that the tenant used when it was launched. Or, if you need to change the name of the VLAN, delete the tenant and redeploy.

bugs.title: File import should check that the target doesn't exist
bugs.symptoms: File import will fail if the same file name already exists.
bugs.conditions: Importing a file that already exists on the file system.
bugs.impact: An error occurs if the file already exists.

bugs.title: Tenant deployment will fail when we move tenant (deployed with max vCPU) from provisioned to deployed
bugs.symptoms: Tenant deployment will fail when moved (deployed with max vCPU) from provisioned to deployed while the old resources are still terminating in the system.
bugs.conditions: When the same tenant is redeployed immediately, the appliance cannot allocate resources as the old resources were not released to the system yet. This issue is observed only on r2k/r4k but not on r5k/r10k.
bugs.impact: Tenant deployment will be stuck in a pending state forever.
bugs.workaround: Move the tenant to provisioned state and wait for the tenant resources to terminate completely in the system and then move it to a deployed state.

bugs.title: VLAN sharing isn't allowed on r2000 and r4000 systems
bugs.symptoms: This is a product limitation in F5OS-A 1.1.0 on r2000 and r4000 based systems. These platforms are unable to use the same VLAN for two different tenants, but the F5OS-A software does not prevent you from configuring them.
bugs.conditions: Assigning an identical VLAN to two different tenants.
bugs.impact: Same VLAN traffic will not be shared between multiple tenants.

bugs.title: Log files collected by QKView are truncated with the newest entries removed
bugs.symptoms: If log files are exceedingly large, they may be truncated when collected by QKView from the 'bottom-up', meaning that the most recent log entries are clipped.
bugs.conditions: Log files exceed the maximum file size (default 500 MB) specified during QKView creation.
bugs.impact: Most recent log entries are clipped, making diagnosis difficult.
bugs.workaround: Collect the log files manually.
bugs.fix: QKView log files are now truncated 'top-down', preserving the most recent log entries.

bugs.title: Container api-svc-gateway crashes due to certificate issues partition database
bugs.symptoms: The api-svc-gateway container crashes when a bad self-signed certificate or key is published to partition database.
bugs.conditions: A corrupted certificate/key causes the issue.
bugs.impact: The api-svc-gateway service crashes.
bugs.workaround: Run the following command: (config) # system database reset-to-default proceed
bugs.fix: In the scenario this happens, api-svc-gateway now: * detects when it cannot set up an SSL connection using these credentials * logs an error * sets health status to unhealthy with appropriate error and severity * tries to start a GRPC server with only insecure credentials

bugs.title: Customer requires auth token session to be configurable
bugs.symptoms: The restconf token session was not configurable in both F5OS-C and F5OS-A.
bugs.conditions: F5OS-C or F5OS-A webUI.
bugs.impact: The customer experienced a fixed session timeout within one hour and the customer has to log in again to the webUI session.
bugs.fix: This issue is fixed in F5OS-C 1.6.0 and F5OS-A 1.3.0. Now the token session timeout is configurable for up to one day.

bugs.title: SSH connection cannot be allowed/blocked based on source IP address
bugs.symptoms: There is no command in F5OS-A or F5OS-C that can be used to allow SSH connection only from specific (or range) IP addresses. SSH connections are allowed from all source IP addresses.
bugs.conditions: F5 rSeries or VELOS platform
bugs.impact: Malicious users might be able to connect (SSH) to F5OS-A or F5OS-C device.
bugs.fix: The existing command "system allowed-ips allowed-ip ..." is enhanced to support SSH. The command can be used to specify source IP addresses that can establish SSH connection.

bugs.title: Tenant deployment failing with error - "failed to set netlink MAC address: resource temporarily unavailable"
bugs.symptoms: Tenant deployment fails with an error - Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to setup network for sandbox "<id>": [default/virt-launcher-bigiptenant1-1-2ghl7:sriov-net5-bigiptenant1]: error adding container to network "sriov-net5-bigiptenant1": failed to set up pod interface "net9" from the device "sfp_6": failed to set netlink MAC address to 14:a9:d0:02:1a:0f: resource temporarily unavailable
bugs.conditions: Previous tenant teardown did not clean up the virtual function (VF) mac address and reset the VF interface.
bugs.impact: Tenant deployment fails.
bugs.workaround: Identify the VF number in the PF which has the mac address issue then reset the mac address manually using ip command. Ex: ip link set sfp_8 vf 1 mac 00:00:00:00:0d:01

bugs.title: Interface speeds are not reported correctly when linked at a slower speed
bugs.symptoms: RSeries 2xxx/4xxx interfaces support linking at certain speeds slower than the portgroup speed, but the interface speed is reported as higher. For example: -- A portgroup in 25G mode accepts a 10G SFP and link at 10G. The interface speed is reported as 25G. -- A portgroup in 25G mode can link at 1G. The interface speed is reported as 25G. -- A portgroup in 10G mode can link at 1G. The interface speed is reported as 10G.
bugs.conditions: This occurs when using an SFP that only supports a slower speed, or when connecting a 10G copper port to a 1G capable device.
bugs.impact: The interface speed reported in the webUI/CLI is higher than the actual link speed.
bugs.workaround: You can determine the actual link speed using ethtool, for example: -- For port 1.0, use ethtool x557_1. -- For port 5.0, use ethtool sfp_5.
bugs.fix: Now reports correct interface speeds.

bugs.title: Various services may stop working on a system controller if the LCD is malfunctioning
bugs.symptoms: Various services may become unresponsive or not work correctly.
bugs.conditions: LCD is not working or host cannot communicate with the LCD.
bugs.impact: Any functionality that interacts with platform-hal could be impacted.
bugs.workaround: Recover or repair the LCD. Rebooting the affected system controller can also help temporarily.
bugs.fix: Fixed a leak that occurs when platform-hal cannot communicate with the LCD.

bugs.title: Prefix length support to allow multiple IP addresses
bugs.symptoms: Prefix length was not supported previously, and users had to configure one IP per command in order to support multiple source IPs.
bugs.conditions: Always
bugs.impact: Multiple source IP addresses cannot be allowed using a single command.
bugs.workaround: NA
bugs.fix: This improvement supports the configuration of prefix length to allow multiple IP addresses using a single command. Prefix length is an additional parameter in the existing configuration command.

bugs.title: NTP service does not work on rSeries appliances
bugs.symptoms: The NTP service does not work on rSeries appliances that run F5OS-A. Running chronyc ntpdata returns "501 Not authorized"
bugs.conditions: -- rSeries appliance running F5OS-A -- NTP configured
bugs.impact: NTP functionality does not work.
bugs.workaround: Change directory ownership to chrony using below command: chown chrony:chrony /var/run/chrony
bugs.fix: Update ownership for "/var/run/chrony" directory and removed unwanted configuration from "chrony.conf".

bugs.title: VLAN-Listener incorrectly updated on Network Manager component restart
bugs.symptoms: When the Network Manager component is restarted, VLAN Listener entries can be incorrectly updated to each tenant's default Service ID.
bugs.conditions: Network Manager restarts can happen due to system controller restarts, partition upgrades, or a manual restart.
bugs.impact: Some traffic could incorrectly follow the default Port Hash disaggregation algorithm. For example, if a VLAN has been set to use the IPPORT disaggregation algorithm, this reset can cause some of the traffic to revert to using the default Port Hash algorithm.
bugs.workaround: Inside the affected tenants, the cmp-hash field can be changed back to default, then changed back to the desired setting.

bugs.title: Tenant deployment may fail if the memory configured is an odd number.
bugs.symptoms: 1. Tenant deployment fails. 2. System may go into bad state.
bugs.conditions: When memory configured for a tenant is set to an odd number.
bugs.impact: Tenant deployment fails.
bugs.workaround: This issue has been fixed in F5OS-A 1.2.0.

bugs.title: NSO and ASW XBAR packet drops on 10G, 25G, and 40G interfaces.
bugs.symptoms: Unexpected egress packet drops can be seen in XBAR for 10G, 25G, and 40G ports. This is a packet burst congestion issue that overflows XBAR egress buffers. The issue is seen mainly on 10G ports.
bugs.conditions: This issue can happen when customers are using the 10G, 25G, or 40G front panel interfaces.
bugs.impact: The impact is egress packets dropped at 10G, 25G, and 40G front panel interfaces.
bugs.workaround: The workaround for this issue is to upgrade to NSO bitfile version nso_1ST210EU2F50E2VG_v70.2.10.11_d22.06.23.00.bit and ASW bitfile version asw_1ST280EU2F50E2VG_v71.2.12.11_d22.06.15.00.bit. These bitfiles and newer include added packet buffer memory in the XBAR. The added packet buffer memory greatly improves the packet drop issue, but does not resolve it completely. In testing, packet drops were still seen as system throughput approached 190Gb.
bugs.fix: The initial fix for this issue is to add memory to the 10G, 25G, and 40G output buffers. Memory was increased from 4Mb to 8Mb. The added packet buffer memory greatly improves the packet drop issue, but does not resolve it completely. In testing, packet drops were still seen as system throughput approached 190Gb.

bugs.title: NTP (chrony) packet authentication is not fully implemented on VELOS
bugs.symptoms: It is not possible to enable NTP packet authentication.
bugs.conditions: Running a version of F5OS-C earlier than 1.5.0.
bugs.impact: NTP packet authentication is not available.
bugs.fix: Added support for NTP packet authentication.

bugs.title: Tenant running instance status shows some error/warning events in confd
bugs.symptoms: Some error/warning events intermittently occur that are related to 'k3s events stale in cluster' inside confd. But the tenant is actually healthy and functional.
bugs.conditions: Intermittently on system reboots. Tenant Status might not updated in Confd.
bugs.impact: The tenant status is incorrect, but the tenant is actually healthy & functional.

bugs.title: During ISO import, the size was incorrectly displayed as 1
bugs.symptoms: When the ISO file is copied to the /var/import/staging directory, during the verification phase the size of the ISO file was displayed as 1.
bugs.conditions: The size of the ISO file was shown as 1 during the verification phase.
bugs.impact: This was misleading as the file size was in terms of GBs.
bugs.fix: The problem has been fixed to display the ISO file size as - (hyphen) till the verification phase is completed.

bugs.title: IP Fragments are disaggragated incorrectly
bugs.symptoms: IP fragments are all sent to TMM0. They should be distributed to all TMMs.
bugs.conditions: IP fragment traffic.
bugs.impact: Higher than normal amount of traffic being sent to TMM0.
bugs.fix: Fixed in code.

bugs.title: Tenant image filename with special characters allowed to import, but tenant deployment fails
bugs.symptoms: Images imported with special characters in their name like parenthesis cause tenant deployment failure when used to launch a tenant.
bugs.conditions: Tenant image filename contains special characters such as '(' or ')'.
bugs.impact: Image imports, but tenant provisioning and deployed fails.
bugs.workaround: 1. Delete the tenant that is using the "bad" image. 2. Rename the tenant image filename removing the special characters. 3. Re-create the tenant.
bugs.fix: Special characters are handled appropriately in the respective tenant launching applications.

bugs.title: Debug messages logged in platform.log
bugs.symptoms: When performing an ISO install on the hardware, some services log debug messages to platform.log until ConfD comes up.
bugs.conditions: This occurs during an ISO install.
bugs.impact: Unnecessary debug logs are logged to platform.log.

bugs.title: Resolving CVEs on F5OS-A 1.1.0
bugs.symptoms: F5OS-A 1.1.0 is vulnerable to the CVEs mentioned in the bug.
bugs.impact: F5OS-A 1.1.0 is vulnerable to the CVEs mentioned in the bug.

bugs.title: Issues with pulling files from F5OS device using SCP
bugs.symptoms: Unable to pull packet capture files off of the F5OS device using SCP from admin.
bugs.conditions: Download packet capture files using SCP from the admin account.
bugs.impact: Unable to download packet capture files through SCP from admin.
bugs.workaround: N/A ★ This issue may cause the configuration to fail to load or may significantly impact system performance after upgrade *********************** NOTICE *********************** For additional support resources and technical documentation, see: The F5 Networks Technical Support website: http://www.f5.com/support/ The MyF5 website: https://my.f5.com/manage/s/ The F5 DevCentral website: http://devcentral.f5.com/ ****************************************************** Generated: Wed Aug 30 17:10:06 2023 UTC ©2023 F5, Inc.
